items.reason: The question says 'using the bar graph' and the heights of the bars are only in the figure; reading one bar against the scale is the skill. The LP text writes the whole graph in a parenthetical (including Class 2 = 5, which is the answer), which duplicates the figure and should be dropped once the picture is in.

content.title: No. of students absent in each class
content.scale_note_box: small rectangle with a thin GUIDE outline at the top centre

diagram.manim_description: Draw a vertical bar graph on a white background. At the top centre a small rectangle with a thin GUIDE outline holding the text '1 unit length = 1 student'. Below it, centred, the title text 'No. of students absent in each class'. The vertical axis is an INK line with tick marks and the labels 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 from bottom to top, equally spaced, with the axis title 'Number of students' written vertically (rotated 90 degrees) to its left. A faint GUIDE horizontal gridline runs across the full plot width at every one of the 9 labels, 0 to 8. The horizontal axis is an INK line at label 0 with the category labels 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 centred under their bars and the axis title 'Class' centred below them. There are 8 equally spaced slots; each bar has the same width (0.6 of a slot) and equal gaps, fill MARK_FILL, INK outline 2.5 px, standing on the horizontal axis. Bar heights in units of one gridline step, class 1 to class 8: 3, 5, 4, 2, 0, 1, 5, 7. Class 5 has height 0, so no bar is drawn in slot 5 (only its label '5'). No value is written on or above any bar. All text is INK, sans-serif, at least 34 px high on a 1920 px canvas.
visible_text: No. of students absent in each class
must_not_show: numbers written on or above the bars
the words maximum, full attendance or any answer
accuracy_checks: bar heights for classes 1..8 on the gridlines: 3, 5, 4, 2, 0, 1, 5, 7
class 5 has no bar (height 0)
tallest bar is class 8 (7), the 8-gridline is drawn but no bar reaches it
total 3+5+4+2+0+1+5+7 = 27 students absent
gridlines equally spaced at every integer 0 to 8; bars have equal width and equal gaps
diagram.alt_text: Bar graph of students absent in each class: classes 1 to 8 have 3, 5, 4, 2, 0, 1, 5 and 7 students absent; 1 unit of length is 1 student.
